title: Matter — Post Side-Channel Message Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/matters/{id}/messages. Posts a typed-event message to the Matter side-channel (§24.8). Wire format is structured; UIs MAY render as chat but the protocol does NOT define presence, typing indicators, reactions, or threads.

content.description: Textual payload of the message body.format=text envelope.

fabric_id.description: Optional cross-reference to an attached fabric — surfaces in `references.fabric_id` on the resulting `pact.matter.message` event.

section_id.description: Optional cross-reference to a section within `fabric_id`. Ignored if `fabric_id` is absent.
